faq.q: Which school district serves Mission, and how are catchments set?
faq.a: SD75 Mission Public Schools; catchments are address-based — at the downtown sample address used here (7466 Welton St) the locator gives École Mission Central Elementary, Heritage Park Middle School and Mission Senior Secondary; SD75 runs a middle tier (Grades 7–9), and any specific condo address should be confirmed with SD75's School Locator Tool.
